method: Actual Chrome keyboard controls drive the production main loop. Teleports only establish independent starting locations; all reported movement, jump, curb and stop behavior follows real input and RAF samples.

results.test: Real WASD accelerates to 5.4 m/s then settles on release at physical ground height
Space produces a gravity jump and a grounded landing with no stuck vertical speed
Real walking crosses the curb onto the raised Kasumi pavement and is stopped by the solid frontage
Third-person feet use the same physical ground as the first-person eye
Real Shift sprint reaches 9.3 m/s with no diagonal or terrain acceleration exploit
